## Bio

Hi! My name is Xinrui (Rita) Li. I am a second-year ScM student in Molecular Microbiology and Immunology at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, where my current research focuses on Trypanosoma brucei. Before joining Johns Hopkins, I completed my undergraduate studies in Biomedical Sciences at Zhejiang University in China, where I conducted research in tumor immunology.
